systems.system: Plateforme sectorielle intégrée du Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)
systems.owner: hosted by the Institut National de la Statistique (INS); ministry-led under the 2021-2030 SIGE strategic plan, with UNESCO support through PAREC
systems.tiers: central; centralises statistics of all education and training sub-sectors

note: The page describes a platform that centralises and publishes sector statistics, launched 8 May 2025; it states no school-level entry during the year, so it is a census-class platform and gives no fact.
